text.short: Elko, on Idaho Street, since 1990. Family-run, family style, and open from six in the morning to half past nine at night, seven days.
text.today: The longest opening hours of any room in this directory. Breakfast through dinner, every day.
text.table: Homemade soups, Caesar salads, baked potatoes, served family style.
text.note: Toki ona is good place in Euskara — the same two words as Leku Ona in Boise, said the other way round.

seating.note: Family style, by the local paper's account of the house. A diner room as well as a Basque one.
